How to play

    1 of 6

    Goal

    Destroy both enemy Aces to win the game. If the enemy destroys both of yours, you lose.

    If a long stretch of turns passes with no combat anywhere, the game ends in a draw.

    Your cards

    Each side commands a personal deck of 13 cards: 1 Joker, 2 Aces, and the 9, 10, J, Q and K of its two suits. Ranks 2 to 8 do not exist in Checards.

    Red plays diamonds and hearts; Black plays clubs and spades. Red always sets up first and moves first.

    Setup

    Place 7 cards, one at a time, on empty squares in your three home rows. Your two Aces must go down first; after that you pick which of your remaining cards to place next.

    The 6 cards you do not place become your draw pile.

    A turn

    • You get 3 moves per turn. One move shifts one of your cards to a neighbouring square, in any direction.
    • Up to 4 of your cards can share a square.
    • Or draw instead: as the first action of your turn, place the top card of your draw pile on an empty square of your back row. Drawing uses your whole turn.
    • If you have no legal action at all, your turn passes.

    Combat

    Move onto a square that holds enemy cards to attack. A card that attacks cannot move again that turn. Battles are resolved after the turn's moves are done, every card that takes part is revealed, and each stack wins or dies as a whole.

    • Two attacking Aces overwhelm a defending Joker: the defender dies, the attackers live.
    • One attacking Ace trades with a defending Joker: both sides are destroyed.
    • Any other attack that includes an Ace wins automatically. No counter is possible.
    • A defending Joker beats any attack without an Ace.
    • Otherwise the higher total wins. Aces and Jokers count 1, cards 9 to K count their face value (K = 13). An exact tie destroys both stacks.

    Hidden cards

    Enemy cards stay face down until they fight in a battle. Combat reveals every card involved, on both sides, even a stack that is destroyed.

    Cards marked 👁️ have been seen by the other side. Your own cards get the mark too once the enemy has seen them, so you know what to keep hidden.

    Q♥ face-up card hidden enemy 9♣👁️ seen in battle
